The 3-sign (9 times, second only to Cb) would be غ, which cannot be one of the commonest letters. The most frequent 30v.7 sign (Cb, 16 = 20%) and the third (Zg, 8) do not occur in 30r.4, and 30r.4's commonest signs (U = ا 24, Tr = ن 8, Th = ل 8) do not occur in 30v.7. The two blocks share nine sign shapes from the same stock (chevron, ٩, 3, two ع forms, kaf, ㅈ, ٨, small comb; 35 of the 81 signs) but not their values: 30v.7 is in a different alphabet, or the same stock of shapes reassigned.

verdict: no plaintext; inventory only. The 30r.4 key does not read it; no reading forced.
